goals.objective: Build an outline chapter-level evaluation for Alex. Prepare 25 diverse raw headers.md extractions sampled from ~/Documents/Alex3/assets into repository eval artifacts. Each case must contain input.md and a manually editable output.md annotation sidecar. Add a deterministic CLI eval that predicts chapter heading level with the production selector, validates annotations, reports exact-match accuracy and per-case results, and writes a run artifact. Do not change the production selector until manual gold annotations exist. Start a durable optimization loop that can resume after the user completes output.md annotations and then iterate toward the gold outputs. Preserve unrelated dirty-worktree changes.

successCriteria.scenario: Run alex prepare-outline-level-eval against ~/Documents/Alex3/assets for 25 cases, then run alex eval-outline-level; verify 25 case directories each contain input.md and output.md, inputs equal their recorded source headers, and the eval writes a JSON run artifact that reports pending annotations without changing production selection.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/c001-happy.txt containing CLI stdout, parsed corpus count/hash/provenance checks, run artifact path, and cleanup receipt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/c001-happy.txt: 25 exact source copies, manifest hashes verified, baseline run has 25 pending; cleanup: no runtime or temp state created.

successCriteria.scenario: Run alex eval-outline-level on a temporary corpus containing one valid H1-H6 annotation, one TODO annotation, and one malformed annotation; verify valid is scored, TODO is pending, malformed input exits nonzero with a precise path-specific error.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/c002-annotation-boundary.txt containing CLI stdout/stderr, exit codes, and cleanup receipt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/c002-annotation-boundary.txt: valid H2 scored, TODO pending, H7 rejected exit 1 with path; cleanup: removed /tmp/alex-outline-level-qa and verified absent.

successCriteria.scenario: Run the targeted outline eval tests plus alex --help and existing markdown_structure/chunking tests; verify the new command is registered without importing heavy dependencies and existing infer_chapter_level behavior remains unchanged.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/c003-regression.txt containing test and CLI exit codes/output plus cleanup receipt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/c003-regression.txt: 35 focused tests pass, Ruff and MyPy clean; cleanup: no persistent runtime state.

goals.title: Optimize chapter-level selection against manual annotations
goals.objective: After all 25 evals/outline_level/cases/*/output.md first-line annotations are changed from TODO to H1-H6, run the exact-match baseline, diagnose error classes, iteratively improve chapter-level selection to maximize exact accuracy without changing outline extraction, and explicitly protect or isolate the summary_eval fact-partitioning caller before promotion.

successCriteria.scenario: After all 25 output.md annotations are H1-H6, run eval-outline-level with an explicit baseline run ID, inspect every mismatch, implement bounded selector candidates, and retain the best exact-match candidate only when it improves or equals accuracy with simpler behavior.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/g002-c001-optimization.txt containing labeled baseline, candidate run artifacts, per-case deltas, and cleanup receipts.

successCriteria.scenario: Reject optimization when any annotation remains TODO, is outside H1-H6, or alters the retained outline; verify the loop does not edit production selection or prompt assets under incomplete or malformed gold data.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/g002-c002-gold-boundary.txt containing CLI failures, unchanged production diff, and cleanup receipts.

successCriteria.scenario: Before any production promotion, run chapter selection through process-doc and summary paths and explicitly verify summary_eval fact partitioning remains stable or is isolated behind its own selector; run Ruff, MyPy, focused tests, and manual CLI QA.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: evals/outline_level/evidence/g002-c003-regression.txt containing caller-level artifacts, checks, QA, and cleanup receipts.
